edges.reason: Constructor argument _botProtection is stored into the stopTheBots state variable.
TechToken constructor argument is forwarded into the BotProtected base constructor.
TechToken constructor invokes the base BotProtected constructor.
Modifier parameter _from is encoded and sent into the external stopTheBots call.
Modifier parameter _to is encoded and sent into the external stopTheBots call.
Modifier parameter _value is encoded into the external bot-check call.
uniPair state variable is supplied as the pair argument of the bot-check call.
The checkBots modifier executes the low-level call to stopTheBots before the guarded body.
External bot-check call executes before balance/allowance updates in transferFrom, allowing reentrant entry.
tx.origin is read and used directly as the contract owner value.
The owner state variable receives the tx.origin-derived value.
tx.origin is granted an unlimited allowance on the pair inside the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the sender when transfer/transferFrom processes a transfer.
transfer forwards its _to argument into transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _value argument into transferFrom.
TechToken.transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
_from parameter selects the balance and allowance entry modified in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives the subtraction and addition operations in transferFrom.
_to parameter selects the credited balance entry in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from the allowance mapping without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction writes the reduced allowance back into the allowance mapping.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction writes the debited balance back into balanceOf.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
Unchecked addition writes the credited balance back into balanceOf.
_from indexes the storage slot read and written in transferFrom.
_to indexes the credited storage slot in transferFrom.
_spender parameter selects the allowance entry set in approve.
_value parameter sets the granted allowance in approve.
msg.sender owns the allowance entry modified by approve.
msg.sender is compared against owner to gate the delegatecall entry point.
User-supplied address a becomes the delegatecall target.
User-supplied calldata b is executed through delegatecall.
delegate executes the unsafe delegatecall after the owner check.
tokenA parameter of pairFor participates in token sorting and hashing.
tokenB parameter of pairFor participates in token sorting and hashing.
tokenA may be assigned to local token0 depending on ordering.
tokenB may be assigned to local token0 depending on ordering.
tokenA may be assigned to local token1 depending on ordering.
tokenB may be assigned to local token1 depending on ordering.
Sorted token0 is hashed into the computed pair address.
Sorted token1 is hashed into the computed pair address.
The computed pair address is stored into the uniPair state variable.
The constructor calls pairFor to derive the pair address.
msg.sender is checked against owner to authorize the listing routine.
_numList is written directly into balanceOf[address(this)].
_toWho array drives the recipient iteration in list.
_amounts array supplies the values written in the list loop.
totalSupply participates in the unchecked totalSupply * 6 / 100 computation.
The unchecked multiplication/division result is assigned into balanceOf[msg.sender].
block.timestamp is read to construct the transaction deadline.
The timestamp-derived deadline is passed as an argument to the router call.
list invokes the external router addLiquidityETH call.
list performs a second external low-level call to stopTheBots with the recipient array.
_toWho array is encoded into the external stopTheBots call.
The external call occurs before the balance-writing loop, enabling reentrant state overwrite.
The loop writes attacker-supplied amounts directly into balanceOf entries.
_toWho entries select which balances are overwritten.
_amounts entries are the values forced into balances.
The list loop performs the arbitrary balance overwrite and Transfer emissions.
The external router call executes before the balance loop, permitting reentrancy into list.
